transcript.text: Hi everyone. I understand Rafael wants to do an informal exchange for some maintenance work on his cargo e-bike. Before I decide whether to accept, I'd like to follow my usual practice here at the workshop: Rafael, can you state the proposed terms of the exchange as you see them? And whoever inspected the bike, please share any technical concerns you found — particularly anything about the mechanical controls and hydraulic brakes, since I need to make sure any brake service uses a safe treatment.
